messages:
Ravi: Hi all, day 3 here. Trying to wire up secrets for a new service. Quick checklist: how do I request secrets for staging vs prod, who signs off on prod, and any minimal rotation rules I should follow?

OpsBot: Hey @Ravi — start with the vault-request template in #help or our GH templates: https://redwood.dev/internal/templates/vault-request. Include service id, owner, envs, and approver for prod.

Nina: Hi! Short answer: create the vault-request ticket and include the desired path (we prefer secrets/teams/<team>/<service>/<env>/<name>), whether it's KV v2 static or dynamic (DB/short-lived). For prod access you must name a human approver (team lead or PM).

Nina: Example KV v2 put (staging/dev only):
```
vault kv put secret/teams/payments/pay-processor/staging STRIPE_KEY="REDACTED"
```

Nina: If you want DB creds, ask for the DB plugin dynamic role. That way Vault issues ephemeral creds with leases — no manual rotation.

Ravi: For encryption keys: should I request an AWS KMS CMK or use Vault Transit? Which one do we default to?

Security: Use AWS KMS CMKs for long-term key material (backups, S3 encryption) and when you need account-level key management. Use Vault Transit for ephemeral signing/encrypting and token wrapping. If you need customer-managed KMS, add the KMS ARN to the ticket.

Nina: Also: if your service runs in GCP, add the GCP project id and service account email in the ticket so we can configure the GCP auth method and IAM bindings.

Ravi: Rotation rules — what's the minimum I should set?

Nina: Prefer dynamic creds (no rotation needed). For static secrets: set an owner in the ticket and propose a cadence — our defaults: 30 days for public-facing API keys, 90 days for internal tokens. If special requirements, note them. Use vault-agent or the SDK to fetch secrets at runtime; do NOT bake secrets into images.

InfraOncall: Emergency prod access: tag @InfraOncall in the ticket and include business justification. We expect a post-incident rotation if emergency access was used.

Ravi: Great — I'll draft the ticket and paste it here for review before submitting. Thanks!

OpsBot: Tip: include whether you want KMS-wrapped secrets or Transit, and indicate TTL/lease expectations. We can help configure automatic rotation jobs if needed.
